newsitem.title: USA: Gynecare in deal with Johnson & Johnson.
newsitem.headline: Gynecare in deal with Johnson & Johnson.

text.p: Medical device developer Gynecare Inc said on Monday that it had signed a definitive agreement with Johnson & Johnson for a $79 million stock-for-stock merger.
The merger, valued at $8.46 per fully diluted share, is subject to approval by Gynecare shareholders and to antitrust clearance, Gynecare said in a statement.
Stockholders holding more than 50 percent of the outstanding shares of voting stock of Gynecare have already agreed to vote in favor of the merger, the company added.
Gynecare Inc designs and develops medical devices for the treatment of uterine disorders.
